title: The First Wake · The Geometry of Becoming

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same encounter can involve very different amounts of change for its participants.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: In this novel, those distinctions shape work, relationships, and what growing older can mean.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You encounter them through situations before deciding what their wider consequences might be.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before the investigation continues, Skein makes Rill arrange enough Length for the journey.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Length concerns the becoming a process can sustain while remaining coherent.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Market exchanges conditions that allow processes to continue, rather than bags of transferable time.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Slack names computational freedom that has not already been committed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Accepting a contract can therefore make some future explorations harder to afford.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The scene gives an unfamiliar economy a recognizable pressure: commitments narrow your room to act.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also shows how carefully the novel distinguishes its invented terms from ordinary objects.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Rill and Skein share a Braid, a bond between parts of their possible futures.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They do not merge into one mind or reveal every thought.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The relationship preserves difference while allowing each to change the other’s possibilities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: As their bond develops, some decisions depend on what the other can contribute.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That makes intimacy more than a message passing between otherwise independent selves.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It becomes part of how each participant can continue being themselves.
